title: A certified three-equilibrium bound for 375 fixed quadratic zero-one reaction networks
description: Article v1 and exact certificates for at most three distinct positive equilibria, including degenerate equilibria, at all positive rate constants in the fixed 375-network list of Tang and Zhang. Includes 375 Cramer reductions, a second resultant route checked with explicit Sylvester determinants, a post-selected finite structural observation, and one seven-reaction family with a rational witness. The original enumeration, 373/2 classification, exceptional identifiers and Lemma 3 are Tang–Zhang results; the original enumeration and the 373-network stability classification are not reverified here. Upstream raw data are not bundled; their pinned input is fetched and hashed. No priority, proof-assistant assurance or human peer review is claimed. Original prose and derived certificates: CC BY 4.0. Code: Apache 2.0. Companion A citation and publication identifiers are pending.
